[package]
name = "ctests"
authors = ["Ivan Nikulin <inikulin@cloudflare.com>"]
edition = "2024"
publish = false

[dependencies]
lol_html = { path = "../../" }
lol_html_c_api = { path = "../" }
libc = "0.2.139"

[build-dependencies]
cc = "1.2.27"
glob = "0.3.2"

[profile.release]
panic = "abort"
lto = true

name: CI

on:
  pull_request:
  push:
    branches:
      - main

env:
  RUSTFLAGS: -Dwarnings
  RUST_BACKTRACE: 1
  CARGO_INCREMENTAL: 0 # makes cache smaller
  CARGO_PROFILE_DEV_DEBUG: 0

jobs:
  clippy:
    name: Clippy and format
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          submodules: 'recursive'
      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
        with:
          components: clippy, rustfmt
      - name: Check format
        run: cargo fmt -- --check
      - name: Cache cargo registry
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          key: index-${{ hashFiles('Cargo.toml') }}
          path: |
            ~/.cargo/registry/index
            ~/.cargo/registry/cache
      - name: Fetch dependencies
        run: cargo fetch
      - name: Cache target directory
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          key: clippy-${{ hashFiles('Cargo.lock') }}
          path: target
      - name: Run clippy
        run: cargo clippy --all --all-targets --target-dir=target
      - name: Run clippy on integration tests
        run: cargo clippy --all --all-targets --features=_integration_test --target-dir=target
      - name: Run clippy on C API
        run: cargo clippy --all-targets --manifest-path=c-api/Cargo.toml --target-dir=target
      - name: Run clippy on JS API
        run: cargo clippy --all-targets --manifest-path=js-api/Cargo.toml --target-dir=target
      - name: Check docs
        run: cargo doc --no-deps --all --target-dir=target
      - name: Check semver
        uses: obi1kenobi/cargo-semver-checks-action@v2
        with:
          package: lol_html
          feature-group: default-features
          verbose: true
  test:
    name: Test
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          submodules: 'recursive'
      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
      - name: Cache cargo registry
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          key: index-${{ hashFiles('Cargo.toml') }}
          path: |
            ~/.cargo/registry/index
            ~/.cargo/registry/cache
      - name: Fetch dependencies
        run: cargo fetch
      - name: Cache target directory
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          key: target-${{ hashFiles('Cargo.lock') }}
          path: target
      - name: Run Rust tests
        run: scripts/test.sh
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
      - name: wasm-pack install
        run: npm i -g wasm-pack
      - name: Run JS tests
        run: make -C js-api test

[package]
name = "lol_html_c_api"
version = "1.4.0"
description = "Low output latency streaming HTML parser/rewriter"
authors = ["Ivan Nikulin <inikulin@cloudflare.com>", "Joshua Nelson <jnelson@cloudflare.com>"]
edition = "2024"
links = "lolhtml"
rust-version = "1.89"
publish = false

[features]
default = ["capi"]
# Required to exist for cargo-c to work
capi = []

[dependencies]
encoding_rs = "0.8.35"
lol_html = { path = "../" }
libc = "0"
thiserror = "2"

[profile.release]
panic = "abort"
lto = true

[lib]
name = "lolhtml"
crate-type = ["staticlib", "cdylib", "rlib"]

[package.metadata.capi.header]
name = "lol_html"
subdirectory = ""
generation = false

[package.metadata.capi.install.include]
asset = [{ from = "include/lol_html.h" }]

[package.metadata.capi.pkg_config]
name = "lol-html"
filename = "lol-html"

[package]
name = "lol-html"
description = "Streaming HTML rewriter/parser with CSS selector-based API"
license = "BSD-3-Clause"
version = "3.0.2"
authors = ["Ivan Nikulin <inikulin@cloudflare.com>", "Gus Caplan <me@gus.host>"]
repository = "https://github.com/cloudflare/lol-html"
edition = "2024"
rust-version = "1.89"
publish = false

[lib]
crate-type = ["cdylib", "rlib"]

[dependencies]
js-sys = "0.3.97"
lol_html_native = { package = "lol_html", path = "../", version = "3.0.2" }
serde = { version = "1.0.228", features = ["derive"] }
encoding_rs = "0.8.35"
serde-wasm-bindgen = "0.6.5"
thiserror = "2.0"
wasm-bindgen = "0.2.120"

[package]
name = "test_case"
authors = ["Yevgen Safronov <yevgen@cloudflare.com>"]
edition = "2024"
publish = false

[dependencies]
lol_html = { path = "../../" }
lol_html_c_api = { path = "../../c-api" }
rand = "0.9"
encoding_rs = "0.8.35"
libc = "0.2.174"

[build-dependencies]
bindgen = "0.72.0"

[profile.dev]
opt-level=3

test:
	wasm-pack build --target nodejs --dev --out-dir node_modules/lol-html
	node test.js

define TYPE_PAIRS
CStreamingHandlerSink:streaming_sink_t \
CStreamingHandler:streaming_handler_t \
Iter<lol_html_attribute_t>:attributes_iterator_t \
AttributesIterator:attributes_iterator_t \
Attribute:attribute_t \
Comment:comment_t \
Doctype:doctype_t \
DocumentEnd:doc_end_t \
Element:element_t \
EndTag:end_tag_t \
HtmlRewriterBuilder:rewriter_builder_t \
HtmlRewriter:rewriter_t \
Selector:selector_t \
TextChunk:text_chunk_t \
SourceLocationBytes:source_location_bytes_t \
Str:str_t
endef


define create_sed_expr
-e 's/(struct )?lol_html_$(firstword $(subst :, ,$1))/lol_html_$(lastword $(subst :, ,$1))/g' \
-e 's/struct lol_html_$(lastword $(subst :, ,$1))/struct lol_html_$(firstword $(subst :, ,$1))/g'
endef

SED_EXPRS := $(foreach pair,$(TYPE_PAIRS),$(call create_sed_expr,$(pair)))

all::
	cargo expand > /tmp/lol_html_h.rs
	cbindgen -c cbindgen.toml /tmp/lol_html_h.rs | sed -E $(SED_EXPRS) -e 's#///#// #g' > include/lol_html.h
	git --no-pager diff -w -- include/

test::
	cargo run --manifest-path=./c-tests/Cargo.toml

name: Semgrep OSS scan
on:
  pull_request: {}
  push:
    branches: [main, master]
  workflow_dispatch: {}
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 0 20 * *'
concurrency:
  group: semgrep-${{ github.event_name }}-${{ github.head_ref || github.run_id }}
  cancel-in-progress: true
permissions:
  contents: read
jobs:
  semgrep:
    name: semgrep-oss
    runs-on: ubuntu-slim
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v5
        with:
          fetch-depth: 1
      - id: cache-semgrep
        uses: actions/cache@v5
        with:
          path: ~/.local
          key: semgrep-1.160.0-${{ runner.os }}
      - if: steps.cache-semgrep.outputs.cache-hit != 'true'
        run: pip install --user semgrep==1.160.0
      - run: echo "$HOME/.local/bin" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
      - run: semgrep scan --config=auto
